query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_inbound_event(account_id,event_id,authorization_generation,owner_epoch,schema_version,payload,state,retry_at) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,1,$5,'pending',now()+interval '10 seconds' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id JOIN whatsapp_linked_account a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE b.group_jid=$6 AND m.account_id=$1 AND m.authorization_generation=$3 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND b.adopted_at<=$7 AND whatsapp_linked_can_view(b.channel_id,a.user_id)) ON CONFLICT(account_id,event_id) DO UPDATE SET retry_at=now()+interval '30 seconds',attempts=whatsapp_inbound_event.attempts+1
